items.title: Jakobi Meyers: Season-high yardage total in loss
items.text:
Meyers brought in four of 10 targets for 85 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Trevor Lawrence: Comes up short against Giants
items.text:
Lawrence completed 25 of 47 passes for 301 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and rushed three times for seven yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday. He also fumbled twice but recovered.

items.title: Courtland Sutton: Goes without catch in Week 11
items.text:
Sutton didn't corral either of his two targets during Sunday's 38-24 victory versus the Raiders.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Works around another turnover
items.text:
Skattebo rushed 14 times for 34 yards and brought in three of seven targets for 14 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Held in check by Giants
items.text:
Tuten rushed 10 times for 33 yards and brought in all three targets for 20 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
